q: Two Sum: return indices of two numbers that add to target. Constraints: O(n) expected.
answer: Hash map value→index while scanning; watch duplicates.

q: Reverse a singly linked list iteratively and recursively. What is the pointer bug?
answer: prev/cur/nxt; recursive reverse rest then node.next.next = node. Don't lose nxt.

q: Binary tree inorder traversal without recursion. When is Morris traversal worth it?
answer: Stack simulation. Morris: O(1) extra via predecessor threads; mutates temporarily.

q: Climbing stairs / Fibonacci DP: top-down vs bottom-up and rolling array.
answer: dp[i]=dp[i-1]+dp[i-2]; O(n) time O(1) space with two vars.

q: Generate all permutations of a distinct array. Pruning if duplicates exist?
answer: Swap/used[] DFS; sort + skip used[i-1] when nums[i]==nums[i-1].

q: Number of islands: DFS vs BFS vs Union-Find. Grid mutation vs visited set.
answer: Flood fill 4-dir. UF if extra union queries; watch index i*n+j.

q: Binary search template: first True in a monotonic predicate. Off-by-one?
answer: lo, hi exclusive vs inclusive. Mid bias; prove loop invariant.

q: Container with most water / two pointers. Why move the shorter line?
answer: Width shrinks; only height increase can win → move min height pointer.

q: Kth largest in a stream: heap size invariant.
answer: Min-heap of size k; peek is kth. Contrast quickselect average O(n).

q: 0/1 knapsack rolling array: why iterate capacity backward?
answer: Avoid reusing item in 1D DP. 2D is clearer; space optimize last dim reverse.
